'''Alin Seroku''' is a gate officer from [[Kandor]].
 
== Appearance ==
He is a bluff, graying man with white scars on his face. 

== Activities ==
He gives warning to [[Lan Mandragoran]] and [[Bukama Marenellin]] to keep the peace inside [[Canluum]].
